claims.claim: Standard sequence classification uses tokenizer + model, logits and supervised loss.

claims.claim: PyTorch random seed controls are not full cross-device determinism guarantees.

claims.claim: Macro F1 is the unweighted mean of per-class F1, with precision and recall definitions.
claims.verification_note: Zero-division convention must be stated for absent class predictions.

claims.claim: BERT paper downstream evaluation separates classification and token-level or span tasks.
claims.verification_note: Intent classifier tutorial does not assert full NER/QA reproduction.
